name: Koenigsegg Hypercars
description: Adds 6 rideable Koenigsegg hypercars: Jesko, Gemera (4-seat Mega-GT), Agera RS, Regera, CC850, and One:1. Features 2x2 twill & forged carbon fiber, 9 multi-stage clearcoat & tinted carbon finishes, perforated Alcantara, diamond quilted leather interiors, dihedral synchro-helix doors, and distinct V8, turbo flutter, and electric motor audio.
